Position Summary The Sourcer executes all strategic sourcing activities in partnership with the Private Destinations talent acquisition initiatives across entry levels and functions. Partners with the necessary team(s) to establish, develop, and maintain relationships with hiring managers. Provides support of inbound sourcing (candidate / req management) as needed. Good working knowledge in recruitment strategies and talent pool management Knowledge of accepted human resources practices and the laws governing employment and fair treatment of employees globally. Must have a flexible approach to change, is able to work effectively in a variety of situations, seeks improvements and looks to the future. Strong written and presentational skills; ability to clearly communicate complex messages to a variety of audiences including management.
